body.statement: For every \(\mathbf P\in\mathcal P(\mathbb B_d)^K\), \(0\le V(\mathbf P)\le r\), and \(\sup_{\mathbf P\in\mathcal P(\mathbb B_d)^K}V(\mathbf P)=r\). Equivalently, \(\sup_{\mathbf P}K^2\{L(\mathbf P)-\|\bar\mu\|_2^2\}=\min\{K,d\}\).
body.justification: The exact deterministic distance from the mean floor governs the large-arm transition before any empirical-process analysis begins.
body.gap: Gao--Ge--Qian's Lemma D.2 yields a dimension-blind order bound on optimal sums; Wang--Wang characterize joint mixability only for selected univariate families.
body.consumer: A causal analyst can certify when the unidentified second-moment improvement over the mean floor is uniformly too small to justify solving MOT.
